facts.fact: Universal Ads by Comcast published this blog post about its self-serve political advertising path on September 15, 2026.
The Universal Ads self-serve platform for premium TV is described as having three steps: create an account, build the campaign, and launch and measure.
facts.quote: For advertisers new to premium TV, the Universal Ads self-serve platform makes the process simple with three quick and easy-to-follow steps.

facts.fact: Step 1 of the Universal Ads onboarding asks advertisers to provide information to verify their organization and establish account eligibility.
facts.quote: Provide the information needed to verify your organization and establish account eligibility.

facts.fact: Universal Ads political targeting covers geographies as granular as ZIP codes, along with age and gender.
facts.quote: They can quickly reach key voter audiences with targeting across geographies as granular as ZIP codes, age, and gender

facts.fact: Universal Ads political targeting also includes party affiliation and voter type, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: as well as critical political targeting such as party affiliation, voter type, and more.

facts.fact: Advertisers who already have a relationship with Comcast Advertising can work with their current seller to activate campaigns on Universal Ads.
facts.quote: If an advertiser has an existing relationship with Comcast Advertising, they can work with their current seller to activate.

facts.fact: The post refers to the 2026 midterm elections as quickly approaching.
facts.quote: As the 2026 midterm elections quickly approach
